stand_out.why: GET /k/{key} p99 2.8 s is over its objective while cp-1 and cp-3 meet it; throttled in 100% of CPU periods while the rest aren't. What's different about it: its CPU limit is 0.25 cores; the rest have 2 cores; its batch_size is 36, set by rule:batch_backoff; the rest have 64
stand_out.look: metrics, history or profile with instance="cp-2", then set_knob with instance="cp-2" to change it there alone

knobs.name: batch_size
knobs.about: Most cache misses fetched from the origin in one request.

knobs.name: sched_target
knobs.about: Threshold for the batch_backoff rule: Go scheduler latency p99 above this makes the rule lower batch_size.

knobs.name: log_level
knobs.about: slog level: -4 debug, 0 info, 4 warn, 8 error.

knobs.name: scan_limit
knobs.about: Requests per second admitted from the scan tenant (X-Tenant: scan); the rest get 429.

knobs.name: compress_level
knobs.about: Response compression level (flate), 1 to 9: higher compresses smaller.

rules.name: batch_backoff
rules.warning: batch_size doesn't spend cpu, which sched.p99 measures: this rule may not be able to help. If turning it up uses cpu, declare vis.Uses(vis.CPU) on the knob.

signals.name: hit_rate
signals.about: Share of lookups served from the cache, over the last closed 10 s bucket.

signals.name: batch_wait_p99
signals.about: How long cache misses waited for their origin batch to start, p99 over the last closed 10 s bucket.

signals.name: response_kb
signals.about: Average compressed response size, over the last closed 10 s bucket.

signals.name: origin_keys_per_s
signals.about: Keys fetched from the origin per second, over the last closed 10 s bucket.

signals.name: rejected_rps
signals.about: Requests per second refused by scan_limit, over the last 10 s.

signals.name: tenant_rps.web
signals.about: Requests per second from tenant web (X-Tenant), over the last 10 s, admitted or not.
